facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: corrective action - material unwanted event control at LA-7201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on LA-7201 and ZV-7210 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. LA-7201 (marine loading arms) is in service for ship loading. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 15 May 2024 a corrective action on LA-7201 and ZV-7210 at Cape Verity Export Terminal was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
